violent.label: Violent / Tense
modifiers: two groups clashing, shoves and raised fists
a tense standoff, weapons half-drawn
open shouting, figures scrambling apart

charming.label: Charming / Idyllic
modifiers: chatting in small groups, shoulders relaxed
heads tipped back laughing, hands resting on shoulders
leaning back, unhurried gestures, quiet smiles

satirical.label: Satirical / Comedic
modifiers: exaggerated poses and faces, wide grins, arms flung out
one figure hamming it up, arms spread, a deep theatrical bow
grimaces and raised eyebrows, oversized gestures

eerie.label: Eerie / Uncanny
modifiers: figures frozen mid-step, heads turned all the same way
faces too still, gazes fixed on something out of view
lips pressed shut, eyes tracking movement

mundane.label: Mundane / Domestic
modifiers: heads down over everyday tasks, eyes on their work
going about separate tasks, barely glancing at each other
hands in pockets, small talk, mid-stride

triumphant.label: Triumphant / Victorious
modifiers: fists pumped, chins lifted
hands raised overhead, backs straight, wide grins
shoulders dropping, heads tipping back, wide smiles

melancholy.label: Melancholy / Wistful
modifiers: seated figures, elbows on knees, eyes down
slow to leave, glancing back over one shoulder
downcast eyes, slack shoulders, slow small movements

solemn.label: Solemn / Ceremonial
modifiers: standing in neat rows, hands folded, eyes down
measured, deliberate movement, heads bowed
slow deliberate gestures, straight backs, silence

romantic.label: Romantic / Tender
modifiers: two figures standing close, foreheads nearly touching
leaning into each other, faces turned toward one another
a long held gaze, soft smiles

restless.label: Restless / Anxious
modifiers: shifting weight foot to foot, hands rubbing together
fidgeting hands, eyes darting sideways
hands balled into fists, tight shoulders, short glances
